newsitem.title: USA: Norwegian Cruise to lengthen two ships.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian Cruise to lengthen two ships.

text.p: Norwegian Cruise Lines (NCL) will lengthen two ships next year at a German boatyard, adding cabins, shops and restaurants to vessels launched in the early 1990s, the company said Friday.

NCL said in a news release that both the Dreamward and the Windward will be stretched with the insertion of 130-foot midsections, adding 256 double-occupancy cabins to each vessel. Each ship will measure about 45,000 tons and 754 feet, up from 41,000 tons and 624 feet.
After the work is completed at the Lloyd Werft shipyard in Bremerhaven by mid-May 1998, the Dreamward will be renamed the Norwegian Dream and the Windward the Norwegian Wind.
